# PetriDishNCA

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A neural cellular automaton (NCA) model where cells evolve in a petri-dish-like spatial substrate, enabling open-ended discovery of emergent patterns and behaviors. Provides a scalable, spatially-constrained framework for studying emergent computation and self-organization in neuromorphic substrates, directly relevant to in-network neural dynamics.
